gate.rule: Beat both baselines on paired issue-anchor MAE and MASE at 8 AND 12 weeks.
gate.caveat: Selection uses this retrospective comparison; it is not independent confirmation or a clinical deployment approval.

protocol: Fixed original model settings. Weekly training snapshots; label release <= issue. Rebuilt paired Stage 2 cases on retrospectively harmonised current acute footprints. The 50:50 blend was selected post-hoc on the Stage 3/4 back-test.
limitations: Approximate first releases and latest revised values; not reconstructed historical vintages.
Global reversion coefficients are predictive associations, not causal effects.

review.bias_rule: Per-horizon expanding mean actual-minus-raw-prediction from earlier issues with target release <= issue; zero until 200 cases.
review.blend_rule: Fixed 50:50 LightGBM/last-value blend selected post-hoc on the Stage 3/4 back-test; weight not continuously fitted or searched. This is not independent validation.
review.large_swings_rule: abs(actual - last) > 0.30 * last; zero last includes any nonzero actual.
review.large_swings_caveat: Outcome-defined, post-hoc diagnostic slice; not a group identifiable at forecast time.
review.evaluation_caveat: Requested after inspection of Stage 3 results; all additions and selection remain exploratory.

national_display.reason: Only paired cohort sums have been evaluated; full England coverage and aggregate intervals are not established. No national model forecasts exported.

review.selection_rule: Use fixed blend if it beats both original baselines on trust MAE/MASE at 8/12w and naive paired-sum MAE at all horizons; otherwise retain Stage 3 selection.

merger_impact.interpretation: Overall results use changed trust units/cohorts; changes are not an isolated causal effect of merger correction. The 50:50 blend was selected post-hoc in Stage 4.
